seo.title: Careers
seo.description: Working at Altrazen: what the job is, who it suits, and how hiring works. We are growing carefully and hire for judgement over years of experience.

hero.heading: Engineering, without the theatre
hero.description: We are a small studio growing carefully. That means fewer people, more responsibility each, and no layer of process between you and the work.

whatItsLike.heading: What it's like here
paragraphs: You own things end to end. Not a ticket queue and not a slice of someone else's design — a problem, from understanding it to running it in production. That is more responsibility than most junior roles carry and it is the fastest way anyone learns.

You talk to clients directly. There is no account manager between you and the person whose business depends on what you are building, which means being able to explain a technical trade-off to someone who does not write software.
You read a lot of other people's code. Some of it is strange, much of it was written under pressure, and none of it is your fault. Curiosity survives this better than perfectionism does.
The work is small and reviewable. Nobody here ships a two-thousand-line pull request, and nobody is asked to review one.
We are remote and asynchronous by default, with a few hours of overlap for calls. We measure what ships, not hours logged.

whoFits.heading: Who this suits
items: You would rather delete code than add it.
You find a well-placed index more satisfying than a new framework.
You can write clearly. Reports, documentation and client updates are half the job here.
You are comfortable saying "I don't know yet" to a client, and then going and finding out.
You have actual opinions about backups, error handling and what belongs in version control.
You care whether the thing works for someone using a keyboard and a screen reader.

steps.title: You write to us
steps.description: A short note about what you have built and what you want to work on. No cover letter theatre, and we do not need a portfolio site. A repository or a description of something you are proud of is worth more than a CV.

steps.title: A conversation
steps.description: Forty-five minutes about how you think and what you have worked on. Not a quiz on algorithms you last used at university.

steps.title: A paid exercise
steps.description: A real, small piece of work that looks like the actual job — usually reading a messy codebase and writing up what is wrong with it. Paid at our normal rate, timeboxed, and yours to keep whatever we decide.

steps.title: A decision, quickly
steps.description: You hear back within a week either way, with a real reason. We will not leave you waiting or send a template rejection.

emptyState.heading: No roles open right now
emptyState.description: We are growing, but we post roles only when we are genuinely ready to hire — collecting applications for jobs that do not exist wastes your time. If you work the way this page describes and want to be first in line when that changes, send us a note about what you have built and we will keep it on file.
